examples.japanese: {女子学生|じょしがくせい}の{割合|わりあい}が{増|ふ}えた。
examples.english: The proportion of female students increased.

examples.japanese: この{大学|だいがく}の{工学部|こうがくぶ}は{女子学生|じょしがくせい}が{少|すく}ない。
examples.english: The engineering department of this university has few female students.

examples.japanese: {昔|むかし}は{女子学生|じょしがくせい}が{大学|だいがく}に{通|かよ}うことは{珍|めずら}しかったが、{今|いま}では{半数|はんすう}を{占|し}めている。
examples.english: In the past, it was rare for female students to attend university, but now they make up half.

notes:
A straightforward compound of {女子|じょし} (female, woman) + {学生|がくせい} (student). Used in both formal and neutral contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}の{割合|わりあい}: proportion of female students
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}{向|む}け: aimed at female students
- {女子学生|じょしがくせい}{寮|りょう}: women's dormitory

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {男子学生|だんしがくせい}: male student — the counterpart
- {女子大生|じょしだいせい}: female university student — specifically refers to college/university level
- {女生徒|じょせいと}: female pupil — used for middle school and high school students
- {女学生|じょがくせい}: schoolgirl — a slightly older term with similar meaning
